title: mimid: parent-dependent rooms are parsed but not implemented, so no call room can be hosted
description:
Found 2026-11-23 (bead mimid-1wgh.37.106).

room-policy-04 §5 L542 names the call room: "A room can be both
fixed_membership and parent_dependent, for example, for room used for a
multi-media call of clients in a Group DM". mimid cannot host one.

WHAT MIMID DOES TODAY: it PARSES the field. limits.rs:150 checks the
`parent_room` URI against the URI limits, and hub/state.rs:246 and
agent.rs:5269 both set `parent_room: vec![]`. Nothing enforces or uses
it.

WHAT §5 REQUIRES and mimid does not do:
- a parent-dependent room's participants MUST be a strict subset of the
  parent's;
- a user removed from the parent is automatically removed from every
  parent-dependent room of that parent;
- a parent-dependent room is always hosted on the same hub as its
  parent;
- `parent_room` MUST be set when the flag is true, and zero-length
  otherwise.

The second one is the interesting one to implement: it is a cascade the
hub has to run on every removal from a parent room, which is new hub
behaviour rather than a validation rule.

AND IT CANNOT BE IMPLEMENTED AS WRITTEN for the obvious case, which is
our own open issue ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-room-policy#40: a call containing
everyone in the Group DM is not a STRICT subset of it, so the rule
forbids exactly the example the note gives. Implementing this means
choosing a reading, which per AGENTS.md is a decision bead citing the
section and the competing readings. The candidate readings are "strict"
as written (and the note's example is simply impossible), or "subset" as
#40 suggests.

So this bead is blocked on nothing technically, but its first step is
that decision, and #40 being answered upstream would settle it. Low
priority until calls matter.
notes: THREE DECISIONS TAKEN 2026-11-23, all closed, so the agent half is unblocked: mimid-1wgh.110 (subset not strict subset, implemented), mimid-1wgh.111 (the cascade is a hub proposal, reusing the operator-removal path, since the hub is not an MLS member and cannot commit), mimid-1wgh.112 (media_keys takes a private-use component id, 0xf021, with the draft suggesting 0x0024) and mimid-1wgh.113 (a client-visible primitive with a one-call convenience over it, the convenience implemented in terms of the primitive so there is one code path to the room). The build order is on mimid-1wgh.113: HostOptions gains parent-dependent rooms, then a Store action for the media secret, then the convenience, then the JMAP surface. Steps 1 to 3 are what the keying demo needs.
